points.point: Non-signaling mode means RF measurements are executed without a signaling connection, and is used in production to save test time
points.label: covered
points.why: defines measurements without live signaling connection and links to fast production testing

points.point: R&S CMP180 is positioned as the production-phase non-signaling RF measurement tester, covering cellular and non-cellular technologies
points.label: partial
points.why: states CMP180 is production non-signaling tester, but only vaguely covers cellular and non-cellular scope

points.point: CMP200 plus CMPHEAD30/CMPHEAD50 RRH form the 5G NR FR2 (mmWave) nonsignaling one-box test solution for RF parametric testing in R&D and manufacturing
points.label: missing
points.why: no CMP200, CMPHEAD30/50, FR2/mmWave one-box solution

points.point: Non-signaling RF is listed as a distinct test type in the 5G device testing value chain, with production/manufacturing mapped to CMP180 / CMP200 / CMW100 while signaling is mapped to CMX500 / CMW500
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions distinct non-signaling RF vs signaling categories, but omits CMP200/CMW100/CMW500 mapping

points.point: Whether the customer needs non-signaling ATE / multi-port production test or factory-line non-signaling capability is an explicit qualification question driving platform choice
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention explicit qualification questions for ATE, multi-port, or factory-line capability

points.point: Non-signaling RX/PER measurement capability on CMP180 is option-gated (e.g. CMP-KM365 for WLAN nonsignaling PER), so option selection depends on understanding the mode
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions CMP180 option selection by mode/technology, but not RX/PER option-gating or examples like CMP-KM365

points.point: CMX500 itself has non-signaling use cases (GPRF generator with ARB/CW/dual tone/.wv replay) alongside its signaling role
points.label: covered
points.why: lists CMX500 non-signaling/GPRF ARB, CW, dual-tone, replay, and standalone TX uses

points.point: The non-signaling GPRF generator licensing claim must be separated from technology-specific ARB licensing, which requires KWxxx licences
points.label: missing
points.why: does not discuss GPRF versus technology-specific ARB licensing or KWxxx licences
